name: gateway-email
description: Outbound-only SMTP email gateway. send delivers a one-shot text email via the configured SMTP server.

credentials.name: smtp_host
credentials.description: SMTP server hostname, e.g. smtp.gmail.com (env override: COS_SMTP_HOST)

credentials.name: smtp_port
credentials.description: SMTP server port (default 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit TLS, 25 for plain) (env override: COS_SMTP_PORT)

credentials.name: smtp_password
credentials.description: SMTP authentication password / app password (env override: COS_SMTP_PASSWORD)

credentials.name: smtp_from
credentials.description: Default From: address (env override: COS_SMTP_FROM); falls back to smtp_user when absent
